messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Halcyon (onboarding) asked for a QBR-style cost runbook after an embeddings surge last week. Spike ~4x baseline. Need quick triage + playbook for their renewal discussion next Tue.

daniel_csm: Got it. Do we have exact spend numbers and which routes/models caused it?

ashley_finops: Quick numbers: last 7d total $18,300. Typical weekly $4,500. Peak day 2026-03-11 = $7,200. Majority from embeddings route `/v1/embeddings` with model "embed-xl-open" (~72%).

leo_prod: Sounds like KV prefetch + reembedding of user datasets triggered the burst — they reindexed ~120k docs overnight.

sam_engineer: Confirmed — logs show a batch job hitting embeds with batch_size=512 and no rate-limit. I've throttled the job at source (ingest-worker) and queued a job retry window.

maria_cs: Good. For QBR we should propose: (1) short-term safety net (retainer credits + alert), (2) mid-term: rate-limits + batching + caching, (3) long-term: dedicated embedding pool or quantized model.

ashley_finops: Draft numbers for retainer: 2-week buffer = $9k. Suggested budget-alert thresholds: daily spend > $5k -> pager to cs + email to finance. Also propose a dedicated capacity estimate: 1x A10 pool = ~$12k/mo.

daniel_csm: Can we offer an ops playbook snippet I can send them? Minimal steps and who to call.

sam_engineer: Paste quick playbook:
```
1) Immediately: enable budget-alert halcyon@cs for >$5k/day
2) Short term: cap embeddings throughput on customer route to 4 rps
3) Mid term: enable KV prefix caching for repeated doc embeds
4) Ops fallback: route embeddings to quantized-variant model embed-xl-q8 when latency < 2s
5) If sustained >3 days: propose Dedicated Embedding Pool
```

leo_prod: Also recommend a prompt/ingest audit: dedupe near-duplicates before reembedding.

maria_cs: Action items:
- ashley_finops: confirm retainer amount + put PO template by EOD (owner)
- sam_engineer: create budget-alert and set route cap (by 2pm)
- daniel_csm: schedule 30m enablement w/ Halcyon for Thurs
- leo_prod: write quick one-pager on model swap/quantization benefits

Could we have a one-slide cost appendix for QBR with numbers and the playbook?

ashley_finops: I'll drop a two-row table you can paste. Estimate:
```
Row1: Safety net (2wk retainer) — $9,000
Row2: Dedicated embedding pool (monthly) — $12,000/mo
```
Will add expected burn reduction if caching/batching applied (~40%).

daniel_csm: I can prep the slide. maria_cs want me to cc renewal manager?

maria_cs: Yes cc: renewals@redwood and include the SLA fallback clause. Also capture customer feedback: they said "ingest job lacked visibility", want clearer alerts.

sam_engineer: I'll attach a prebuilt alert rule: `alert: embeddings_daily_spend; condition: sum(24h) > 5000; notify: cs-team, finance` and a playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-burst

leo_prod: I'll draft the quantization recommendation in the docs repo and link it.

maria_cs: Perfect. Final ask: who will join QBR? daniel + leo + ashley + renewals rep. I'll send invite once we confirm slide.

qbr-bot: Summary created for thread 1768124680 — items assigned: ashley_finops (retainer PO), sam_engineer (alerts & caps), daniel_csm (enablement + slide), leo_prod (one-pager). Next update expected 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Thanks team :pray:
